LESSON: SARUFI 14.4.1 UKUBWA WA NOMINO

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.4: Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from Kenya
3. practise Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in clear steps
4. apply Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SARUFI 14.4.1 UKUBWA WA NOMINO
Subject: KISWAHILI · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: SARUFI 14.4.1 UKUBWA WA NOMINO
Study Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino. (skill: practise Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 14.4.1 Ukubwa wa Nomino from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
